items.title: 3-Dots Menu Options Display & Viewport Clipping
items.description: Options menu under each snippet not showing appropriately on click (getting cut off, hidden behind neighboring cards, or clipped by viewport overflow).
items.rootCause: Fixed/relative z-index stacking context inside scrollable list container and viewport boundary clipping on mobile.
items.resolution: Converted 3-dots menu to a fixed backdrop-blurred bottom action sheet on mobile and centered modal with z-50 and e.stopPropagation().

items.title: Mobile Header Menu Item Overflow & Wrapping
items.description: Header navigation items overflowing on mobile screens and wrapping onto awkward rows.
items.rootCause: Long text labels on navigation buttons ('Snippet Clipper', 'Export/Import') wrapping on viewports < 640px.
items.resolution: Converted header navigation actions to compact icon buttons with accessible tooltips, retaining text only on desktop.

items.title: Snippet Clipper Modal Height Cutoff on Mobile
items.description: Snippet clipper modal exceeding mobile screen height and cutting off Point A/B range controls and save button.
items.rootCause: Rigid modal height, fixed padding, and oversized artwork header without flexible scrollable container.
items.resolution: Implemented compact waveform and scrubber layout, responsive album art thumbnail, scrollable body with sticky footer save controls.

items.title: Authentication 401 Rejection on Stale Credentials
items.description: Login attempt failed with 401 when entering admin/admin.
items.rootCause: Expected credentials in .env are admin and bitstream4100; browser state required refresh before re-authentication.
items.resolution: Applied correct credentials (admin / bitstream4100), refreshed page before re-login, verified 200 OK session token issued and stored in localStorage.

items.title: TS2550 Compilation Error: findLastIndex on SyncedLyricLine[]
items.description: Compilation error TS2550: findLastIndex does not exist on type SyncedLyricLine[].
items.rootCause: Array.prototype.findLastIndex requires ES2023 target, while project tsconfig uses an earlier standard library.
items.resolution: Replaced findLastIndex with backwards-compatible iterative reverse search loop (for let i = syncedLyrics.length - 1; i >= 0; i--), achieving 100% build compatibility.

items.title: TS2339 Compiler Error: setMasterVolume on AudioEngine
items.description: Compiler error TS2339: Property setMasterVolume does not exist on type AudioEngine.
items.rootCause: Volume slider in App.tsx called setMasterVolume before method was exposed on AudioEngine class.
items.resolution: Added public setMasterVolume(vol: number) to AudioEngine class adjusting masterGain.gain node with clamp bounds [0, 1].

items.title: Snippet Scrubber Offset & Clamping Bug
items.description: Scrubbing within snippet caused playhead jumping outside Point A/B interval.
items.rootCause: Progress fraction calculation did not clamp to snippet startMs and endMs duration window.
items.resolution: Clamped progressPercent to snippetDurationMs and mapped slider fraction strictly between startMs and endMs.

items.title: Spotify Connect Remote Silent Playback Error
items.description: Spotify Connect remote playback silent error when player device is sleeping.
items.rootCause: Spotify Connect API returns 404 No Active Device when Spotify app is closed or idle on target device.
items.resolution: Built PlaybackNoticeModal providing instant user diagnosis, instructions to wake player, device switcher, and retry trigger.

items.title: Cross-Device Playback Desync & Ghost Snippet Auto-Advance
items.description: When playing music on a different device while an existing device was already playing, music stopped on the device but play continued and it started playing the other bit in this device.
items.rootCause: App.tsx playhead timer ran continuously without listening to Spotify remote playback state or Web Playback SDK events. When another device started playing, Spotify paused the local device, but the local timer kept advancing to snippet.endMs and triggered handleSnippetCompleted() to start the next snippet, interrupting the other device.
items.resolution: 1) Subscribed to Web Playback SDK player_state_changed to immediately catch remote takeover events (state === null); 2) Added Spotify getPlaybackState() poll to check remote is_playing and track URI every 1.5s; 3) Built LAN-level cross-client playback coordinator (/api/playback/sync & /api/playback/status); 4) Guarded playhead timer with isPlayingRef to immediately halt ticks and prevent ghost auto-advance when playback transfers.

items.title: Isolated Stage Environment on Port 3100
items.description: Create separate Stage environment on port 3100 while keeping Production on port 4100 intact.
items.rootCause: Need isolated testing ground for major music app improvements without altering working production.
items.resolution: Created stage/ directory with node_modules directory junction, separate stage/snippets-data.json, PORT=3100, running concurrently alongside Production (Port 4100).

items.title: Flagship 'Neon Nights' Theme
items.description: Introduce flagship Neon Nights theme with dark background, purple gradients, and electric cyan accents.
items.rootCause: Modernize visual aesthetics with premium dark mode and glowing accents.
items.resolution: Added [data-theme='neonnights'] CSS variables: #070512 background, purple radial gradients, electric cyan borders/accents, custom scrollbars, set as default flagship theme.

items.title: Expanded Full Now Playing Screen Modal
items.description: Full-screen expanded Now Playing screen with large album art and vinyl presentation.
items.rootCause: Immersive listening experience with expanded metadata and controls.
items.resolution: Dedicated full modal view with vinyl spinning animation, interactive seek bar, timestamp previews, device status indicator, and multi-tab switcher.

items.title: Real-Time 32-Band Canvas Audio Visualizer
items.description: Real-time 32-band canvas audio visualizer with dynamic gradient bars.
items.rootCause: Dynamic responsive visual feedback representing music playback.
items.resolution: Connected canvas renderer to Web Audio AnalyserNode (fftSize = 64) with neon violet/cyan gradient frequency bars and peak caps; fallback harmonic wave when paused.

items.title: Real-Time Synced & Plain Lyrics via LRCLIB
items.description: Real-time synchronized lyrics via LRCLIB with auto-scroll.
items.rootCause: Allow users to follow along with snippet lyrics automatically scrolled to playback position.
items.resolution: Integrated LRCLIB REST API (https://lrclib.net/api/get), parsed LRC timestamps ([mm:ss.xx]), auto-scrolls smoothly to current active line matching snippet playhead.

items.title: 3-Band Parametric Equalizer & Audition Test
items.description: 3-Band Parametric Equalizer with 6 presets and live audition chord.
items.rootCause: Allow users to shape sound (Bass, Mid, Treble) for headphones or speakers.
items.resolution: Web Audio BiquadFilterNode chain (LowShelf 120Hz, Peaking 1kHz, HighShelf 7kHz) with 6 presets (Flat, Bass Boost, Vocal Clarity, Electronic, Acoustic, Rock) and Audition chord test.

items.title: Sleep Timer with Auto-Pause (15/30/45/60m)
items.description: Sleep Timer with 15m/30m/45m/60m presets and auto-pause.
items.rootCause: Bedtime listening timer that pauses playback automatically.
items.resolution: Sleep timer popover in Now Playing screen (15m, 30m, 45m, 60m) with countdown ticker that automatically pauses audio and displays toast alert.

items.title: Sticky Bottom Mini-Player Bar
items.description: Sticky bottom mini-player bar with full-width scrub line and quick controls.
items.rootCause: Continuous playback accessibility while navigating playlists and snippets.
items.resolution: Persistent bottom player bar across all navigation with full-width top scrubber line, 1-tap heart toggle, volume slider with mute icon (VolumeX/Volume1/Volume2), and expand trigger.

items.title: Liked / Favorites Collection & Filter Tab
items.description: Liked / Favorites collection with 1-tap heart toggle and dedicated top filter pill.
items.rootCause: Quick curation and retrieval of favorite snippets.
items.resolution: 1-tap Heart button on cards and player bar, added isFavorite flag to MusicSnippet, saved to disk & Firestore, with dedicated '❤️ Liked (count)' filter tab.

items.title: Recently Played Section & Filter Tab
items.description: Recently Played tracking and dedicated top filter tab.
items.rootCause: Easy access to previously listened snippets across sessions.
items.resolution: Automatically record played snippets in StorageService.recordRecentlyPlayed(), providing a dedicated '🕒 Recent (count)' filter tab.

items.title: Dynamic Up Next Queue Management
items.description: Dynamic Up Next queue management with 'Play Next' and 'Add to Queue'.
items.rootCause: Give users full control over upcoming tracks.
items.resolution: 'Play Next' and 'Add to Queue' actions in snippet 3-dots menu; built Up Next queue view in Now Playing modal allowing reordering and item removal. Prioritized before playlist in queue advancement.

items.title: Global Animated Toast Notifications
items.description: Global animated toast notification container.
items.rootCause: Immediate tactile feedback for user actions (favoriting, queueing, timer).
items.resolution: Created ToastContainer supporting success, info, warning, and heart alert types with auto-dismiss after 3.2s and glassmorphism glow styling.

items.title: Global Keyboard Accessibility Shortcuts
items.description: Global keyboard playback shortcuts.
items.rootCause: Enable power-user control without mouse navigation.
items.resolution: Added window keydown shortcuts: Space (play/pause), ArrowRight (next), ArrowLeft (prev), M (mute), L (like), F (Now Playing), Escape (close modal).

items.title: Application Authentication Gate Screen
items.description: Application authentication gate screen with persistent session tokens.
items.rootCause: Protect app access while maintaining seamless localhost development.
items.resolution: Created secure gate screen validating against server APP_LOGIN_USER and APP_LOGIN_PASS, issuing session token stored in localStorage.

items.title: Codebase Backup Archive in ZIP File
items.description: Codebase backup archive in zip file.
items.rootCause: Protect working code before undertaking major architectural changes.
items.resolution: Created backups/spotify-bitstream-backup-latest.zip containing complete snapshot of codebase prior to stage modifications.

items.description: Allow authorizing Spotify directly from mobile devices on local network using 192.168.x.x IP addresses with dynamic redirect URIs, OAuth state mapping, and cross-tab/channel sync.
items.resolution: Verified and fixed in stage environment

items.title: Spotify OAuth returns 'redirect uri insecure' when authorizing from mobile LAN IP
items.description: When attempting to authorize Spotify with http://192.168.1.71:3100/auth/callback, Spotify rejects the request with 'redirect uri insecure'. Spotify OAuth 2.1 strictly forbids unencrypted HTTP on non-loopback IP addresses.
items.rootCause: Spotify Developer Platform security policy only permits HTTP on loopback addresses (127.0.0.1 / localhost). All private LAN IPs (192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x) require https:// scheme in redirect_uri.
items.resolution: Verified and fixed in stage environment

items.title: Clean & Sleek Mobile View: Consolidate header icons into unified Mobile Control Center Menu
items.description: Remove cluttered header icon buttons on mobile devices (< 768px) and replace them with a single clean, sleek Mobile Control Center menu drawer featuring Spotify status, Local DB sync, Theme selector, Release Notes, and Clipper.
items.resolution: Verified and fixed in stage environment

items.resolution: Verified and fixed in stage environment

items.title: Animated Audio Equalizer Indicator on Currently Playing Song in Playlist List
items.description: Add an animated 4-bar equalizer sound wave animation and title highlight on the active playing song in the playlist list so users can immediately identify which song is currently playing.

items.title: Fix Snippet Playback Overrun: Point B Cutoff Watchdog in Snippet Clipper & 450ms Remote Latency Calibration
items.description: Fixed saved music snippets and clipper audition playback playing past Point B (endMs). Replaced ambiguous 'Play Song' button with a prominent 'Play Bit (A ➔ B)' audition action, added an active 'Point B Guard' toggle, calibrated 450ms remote Spotify Connect flight latency lead time, integrated a real-time 100ms clock watchdog and 1000ms server progress_ms polling watchdog that forcibly clamps playback and pauses remote devices at Point B, and added multi-tier fallback to spotify.pause().
